Acorn PR1YP, Brown Ceramic Knob With Three Green Leaves

A great natural accent to your home, Acorn's Large Round Brown Ceramic Knob With Three Green Leaves features the bold colors of the great outdoors. Hand painted, each knob is a little different, a little work of art. It has a 1-3/4" diameter. Easy to install, it is a quick way to liven up your kitchen cupboards, your bathroom vanity and your china cabinets.

Features of the Large Round Brown Ceramic Knob With Three Green Leaves:

  • Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
